_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: William Archer's Collected Works of Henrik Ibsen (Heinemann/Scribner Copyright Edition, 1906-1912), the standard English Ibsen. One title per volume (the plays inside are listed in 'work'; per-play cuts can come later). Vols 1-11 are shelved; vol 12 (From Ibsen's Workshop, Chater, 1912) is pending. All US public domain (pre-1931); UK: Archer died 1924, but co-translators Gosse (1928) and Herford (1931) mean UK status varies by play. A Doll's House in R. Farquharson Sharp's translation stays on adler_shelf.json; Archer's is a different translation, i.e. a different witness. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 11); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

_excluded.marx-aveling-wild-duck: PG 73631: Eleanor Marx Aveling's translation; another translator.

_name_words_note: Editor's name: every volume of the edition prints 'with introductions by William Archer', so it is the identity check.
_verified_note: Evidence that each source's rights/identity line was read (lane C review fix, 2026-10-02, pipeline run over the fetched files; no book text recorded). PG: the header's Translator: line and the COPYRIGHTED marker. IA: whether the translator's name appears in the first 30 KB of OCR, and the years printed in the first 15 KB of front matter (scanner/digitizer lines skipped). Any post-1930 year there was examined by eye; see the title's scan_edition.
